title: json-fn cost vector suite
description: Documents the cost vector format consumed from spec/cases/cost. Static vectors pin the region constants that the static cost function derives from a canonical program; fuel vectors pin the deterministic consumed-fuel total of an evaluation or its exhaustion under maxFuel.

description.description: A description of the vector suite.

cases.description: The cost vectors in this suite.

description.description: A description used as the test name.

program.description: The canonical json-fn program to analyze.

regions.description: Every straight-line region of the program with its static constant.

at.description: JSON Pointer to the region's entry node in the canonical program. The empty pointer is the program's entry region.

description.description: A description used as the test name.

comment.description: Optional documentation about the case, conventionally the event-by-event charge derivation.

program.description: The canonical json-fn function to evaluate and apply.

args.description: Arguments the function is applied to.

consumedFuel.description: The exact deterministic fuel consumed by the evaluation. Mutually exclusive with maxFuel and error.

maxFuel.description: A finite fuel budget the evaluation exhausts. Paired with error.

error.description: A substring expected in the exhaustion error. Paired with maxFuel.
